description: Down a staircase of 3-wide rows, each a block lower than the last: walking, then sprinting, the player sneaks for 0 to 3 ticks as it passes each edge, carrying its speed off the step.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
